scope: Host-only actual controller_transaction_adapter.cpp compiled with the explicit LAYA_MANAGED_TRANSACTION_ADAPTER=1 macro, plus one default-macro-off compatibility build/run of the existing adapter test. Managed mode latches transaction-local cancel from the wrapper input while receiving/awaiting the old LTX and before first external presentation. Only PROVENANCE+CANCEL_CLEANUP+END/INVALIDATE may proceed under revoke; RELEASE remains legacy-only cleanup permission. Ordinary complete legal pending frames not yet presented use the real adapter reject_internal/make_local_reject/encode path, with exactly FRAME_COMPLETE|LOCAL_REJECT and no remote facts. external_presented is sticky at the first write_nb attempt, regardless of its result; an old presented frame and its real return continue without reset/FIFO deletion or a second completion. 88 independent host transactions cover first pop, cancellation during empty READ after first pop, half read, last input pop, PREPARE, SEND before first write, after first write and normal operation: 60 local rejections and 28 controlled complete remote returns. Independent fixed LTC wire-offset gold compares every byte; seven caller binding mutations per rejection must remove trust. All actual 24 LTX reads, 16 LTC writes/pops and remote 16 command/8 response transfers are bounded host calls, with response partial framing and retained caller tail2/tail1. Two additional fresh OS processes cover a bad magic COMPUTE frame and a reserved-tail END frame with CANCEL_CLEANUP. After all 24 real input pops, managed full-codec parse failure isolates the retained unknown frame; 256 calls with continuous cancel, live cancel recovery and toggling produce zero LTC/external beats and consume none of the queued next 24-beat frame or peer responses. No adapter reset or caller FIFO clearing is used. Independent fixed-byte input mutations, zero-output gold and 281 actual FIFO observations per process are checked. This proves unknown-input isolation only, not recovery of every malformed frame. Vendor host hls::stream.full() is false, so READY backpressure, an attempted but unaccepted first external write, depth2/F10 final-pop interlock, HLS/RTL generation and actual owner/pending collector integration are NOT_RUN. cancel input is a controlled peer here: immutable old A/K, persistent wrapper revoke, complete executor pending and unique hub scope/physical/retirement remain root-owned integration requirements. No new wire, owner/allocator table, C/LN full tensor, D/QUANT/CLOSE/rearm, new resources/timing or board claim.
